title: What If Humans Could Regrow Limbs Like an Axolotl?

scenes.text: What if you could regrow a lost arm like an axolotl? Your liver already can.
The axolotl can regenerate the form and function of almost any limb, organ, or other body part.
At the wound, a clump of dividing cells called a blastema forms and builds the new limb.
People cannot do that. We heal with scar tissue, knit broken bones, and regrow skin and hair.
Your liver is the exception. Lose part of it, and the rest grows back to its original size.
Our weakest repairs are the heart, spinal cord, and brain, which is exactly why scientists study the axolotl.

description:
What if humans could regrow limbs like an axolotl?
